measured_limitations.sender_history: mean 1.001 transactions per sender, max 3 — every sender-side behavioural feature is inert
measured_limitations.destination_history: mean 2.34 per destination, max 113 — destination-novelty features are exercised
measured_limitations.no_declines: auth_result is always APPROVED, so the two features added by D21 cannot fire
measured_limitations.no_account_age: no opening date, so account_age_days and dormancy report NEVER_SEEN throughout
measured_limitations.no_incidents: fraud is per-transaction; incident-level recall degenerates to transaction-level

therefore: validates that the pipeline runs on foreign data and that threshold discipline holds at a realistic base rate. It cannot validate detection, and it cannot validate the behavioural features that are this system's actual claim.
